titles.title: Goat's Horns with Blue

description: A textured brown goat's horn springs from its skull above a dark gray eye socket. The horn, with its twin barely visible behind it, creates a large circle that fills the composition. A patch of blue sky appears between the horns.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
